testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.tenancy.PublicSiteAuthorizationTests

testcase.name: forged browser authority cannot change the outcome - tenant, workspace, project, release, role, actor kind, tokens and cookies in headers or body are ignored by the chain()
PUBLIC_SITE is a new actor kind that is not a USER and carries no user id, role or permission()
a query of a foreign release is refused and the provider is asked only about the release of the request()
the public route needs no USER session and no CSRF token - and opens nothing else under sites or api()
LIVE only - TEST, draft, case variants and anything else is refused()
a foreign tenant, workspace or project is refused, and every refusal is the same 404()
the USER permission model never admits a PUBLIC_SITE - app access, tenant gate users and principal resolution all refuse it, even with a real user id attached()
QUERY_EXECUTE is the only operation - mutation, data source management, schema, cache refresh, events, sync, webhooks and unknown names are refused()
SYSTEM, SERVICE and APP_TOKEN stay denied for every operation, with and without a user id()
an unpublished query is refused, and so is every malformed query id()
no Studio authority is used - the public route has no session, no CSRF, no user filter, and a Studio login changes nothing()
an empty, missing or failing allow-list denies everything - the Spring-wired policy has no provider yet and so denies all()
an inactive release is refused - not RUNNING, private, offline, rolled back, archived project, suspended tenant()
the pointer is read on every call - after a rollback the old release is refused and the restored one is allowed()
at the data gateway a PUBLIC_SITE needs the full server-derived scope and the active release's version - nothing less, nothing foreign()
LIVE + active public release + a query the release lists is allowed, with the release's own version()
